paper_title: Constructing a new polymer acceptor enabled non-halogenated solvent-processed all-polymer solar cell with an efficiency of 13.8%†

qa_pairs.question: What are the specific chemical components used to construct the polymer acceptor PS1?
qa_pairs.answer: The polymer acceptor PS1 is synthesized by connecting a dithienothiophen[3,2-b]pyrrolobenzotriazole core to 3-(dicyanomethylidene)-indan-1-one (IC) end-caps via a thiophene π-conjugated spacer.
qa_pairs.source_title: Constructing a new polymer acceptor enabled non-halogenated solvent-processed all-polymer solar cell with an efficiency of 13.8%†

qa_pairs.question: How does the incorporation of long alkyl side-chains on the benzotriazole moiety affect the processing of PS1?
qa_pairs.answer: The long solubilizing alkyl side-chains on the central benzotriazole moiety enable PS1 to be soluble in non-chlorinated solvents, specifically 2-methyltetrahydrofuran (2-MeTHF), allowing for more environmentally friendly processing.
qa_pairs.source_title: Constructing a new polymer acceptor enabled non-halogenated solvent-processed all-polymer solar cell with an efficiency of 13.8%†

qa_pairs.question: What are the photovoltaic performance parameters (PCE, Voc, Jsc, and FF) for the PTzBI-oF:PS1 all-polymer solar cell when processed with 2-MeTHF?
qa_pairs.answer: The PTzBI-oF:PS1 device processed with 2-MeTHF achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 13.8%, an open-circuit voltage (Voc) of 0.92 V, a short-circuit current (Jsc) of 22.47 mA cm^-2, and a fill factor (FF) of 66.70%.
qa_pairs.source_title: Constructing a new polymer acceptor enabled non-halogenated solvent-processed all-polymer solar cell with an efficiency of 13.8%†

qa_pairs.question: Compare the optical and electrochemical bandgaps of the PS1 polymer acceptor based on its energy levels.
qa_pairs.answer: PS1 has an optical bandgap of 1.39 eV. Based on its electrochemical energy levels of -5.56 eV (HOMO) and -3.70 eV (LUMO), it possesses a larger electrochemical bandgap of 1.86 eV.
qa_pairs.source_title: Constructing a new polymer acceptor enabled non-halogenated solvent-processed all-polymer solar cell with an efficiency of 13.8%†

qa_pairs.question: How does the choice of processing solvent (2-MeTHF vs. chloroform) influence the absorption coefficient and charge carrier mobility in PTzBI-oF:PS1 devices?
qa_pairs.answer: Processing with 2-MeTHF yields a higher absorption coefficient (7.0 x 10^4 cm^-1) compared to chloroform (5.1 x 10^4 cm^-1). Additionally, 2-MeTHF-processed devices exhibit superior carrier mobilities, with hole and electron mobilities of 2.45 x 10^-3 and 3.57 x 10^-4 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1, respectively, which are higher than those processed with chloroform.
qa_pairs.source_title: Constructing a new polymer acceptor enabled non-halogenated solvent-processed all-polymer solar cell with an efficiency of 13.8%†

qa_pairs.question: What molecular packing orientation is observed in PTzBI-oF:PS1 blend films according to GIWAXS analysis?
qa_pairs.answer: GIWAXS analysis indicates that PTzBI-oF:PS1 blend films exhibit a preferential face-on packing arrangement, evidenced by a strong out-of-plane π-π stacking peak at approximately q = 1.76 Å^-1.
qa_pairs.source_title: Constructing a new polymer acceptor enabled non-halogenated solvent-processed all-polymer solar cell with an efficiency of 13.8%†

qa_pairs.question: What evidence supports the thermal stability of PTzBI-oF:PS1 all-polymer solar cells?
qa_pairs.answer: The high thermal stability is demonstrated by the device retaining approximately 95% of its initial power conversion efficiency (PCE) after undergoing thermal annealing at 80 °C for 60 hours.
qa_pairs.source_title: Constructing a new polymer acceptor enabled non-halogenated solvent-processed all-polymer solar cell with an efficiency of 13.8%†

qa_pairs.question: What is the performance of the PTzBI-oF:PS1 all-polymer solar cell when scaled to a large-area device?
qa_pairs.answer: The PTzBI-oF:PS1 based device demonstrates strong scalability potential, achieving a power conversion efficiency of 12.4% at a large-area scale of 1 cm^2.
qa_pairs.source_title: Constructing a new polymer acceptor enabled non-halogenated solvent-processed all-polymer solar cell with an efficiency of 13.8%†
